name: Homo neanderthalensis (Neanderthal)

alternative_classifications: Sometimes classified as Homo sapiens neanderthalensis (subspecies) rather than a separate species

estimated_percentage_range.applies_to: non-African modern populations; small back-migration-derived signal (~0.3%) also documented in West African populations

notes: Fossil date range (earliest confirmed ~430 ka at Sima de los Huesos; youngest ~39,260-41,030 cal BP) is distinct from the lineage-divergence date from Homo sapiens (~550,000-765,000 years ago, a genetic estimate) — see claim_neanderthal_sapiens_divergence. Do not conflate the two.
